metadata.description: Skills for finding security vulnerabilities in the native dependencies of Node.js and Ruby packages.

plugins.name: fuzzing-native-node-dependencies
plugins.description: Fuzz the native libraries behind NAN/N-API Node addons with AFL++: build a faithful harness, derive a seed corpus from source, run campaigns, and triage crashes against the real npm package.

plugins.name: fuzzing-native-ruby-dependencies
plugins.description: Fuzz the C code behind Ruby gems' C extensions with AFL++: build a faithful harness (mkmf/extconf.rb, vendored mini_portile libraries, Ruby-runtime stubs), derive a seed corpus from source, run campaigns, and triage crashes against the real gem.
